children: Docusign's 2Q revenue rises 9% year over year to $875.7 million, with the company raising its full-year guidance. The acceleration reflects growing enterprise adoption of the company's Intelligent Agreement Management platform, which now represents 15.1% of total annual recurring revenue, up from 12.6% at the end of the prior quarter. The company expects IAM to reach 18% to 19% of total ARR by the end of fiscal 2027. CEO Allan Thygesen says AI is accelerating momentum across the business, with new agentic tools now executing contract workflows.
